summary: Frontend-only verification completed against the public DEMO URL. All 8 requested regression scenarios passed: demo setter state/4-player leaderboard, exact four-source picker without AI auto-source, Manual Entry controls, no-key AI fallback autofill, rich HTML question rendering, setter explanation, subject/chapter cascading dropdowns, and the results-to-next-bot-round loop. Desktop and mobile responsive checks also passed. One additional high-priority HTML/CSS injection issue was reproduced.

integration_issues.issue: User-controlled question/explanation HTML is inserted via innerHTML after an incomplete blacklist sanitizer. A Manual question containing <style>#leaderboard{display:none!important}</style> rendered the style element and hid the leaderboard for the round. Unsafe tags beyond <style> are also not allowlisted.

action_items: Replace rich()'s regex blacklist with a proven HTML sanitizer and a restrictive allowlist that supports intended formatting/images but rejects style, iframe, scriptable SVG and other active content; apply it to questions, options, explanations, and result content.
critical_code_review_comments: game.js rich() only removes script tags, on* attributes, and javascript: strings, but Manual Entry is untrusted multiplayer input. Because renderStage() and showResultsPopup() assign rich() output through innerHTML, CSS/active-markup injection affects every participant. Reproduced in DEMO by hiding #leaderboard with a question-level <style> tag.

success_rate.frontend: 89% overall (8/8 requested regressions passed; 1/1 additional security probe exposed a defect)

seed_data_creation: No persistent data created; DEMO mode is in-memory only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest the exact 8 requested flows at /quizx/quiz%20game/index.html?demo after sanitization. Also verify intended <b> formatting still renders while <style>, iframe, SVG/event handlers, and javascript: payloads are removed. Real Supabase bookmarks/question-bank login paths and real AI-provider calls were out of scope and not tested.
rca_of_the_issue: game.js lines 16-19 implement sanitization with three regex replacements, then rich() output is interpolated into innerHTML at the answering stage, explanation blocks, and results. Regex removal blocks only a small subset of active HTML; Styled question, fill four options, and start the round; #stage .qtext contains the style element and computed display for #leaderboard becomes none.
